rules.statement: A purchaser who fails to register his transfer is not given a preferential position over another purchaser whose transfer, although unconnected with any action, was duly registered.
rules.supporting_quote: "Nor do I see why a person in the position of the plaintiff who has failed to protect himself by registering his lis pendens, and has therefore run some risk during the pendency of the action should not get the benefit of registration when at length he decides to so safeguard Ranasinghe himself."
